policy.runtime: All audio is bundled locally. No CDN, streaming, microphone, speech synthesis, or runtime generation is used.
policy.music: The five release ambience tracks are reviewed user-provided 妙响 masters imported from the local ignored music/ directory with scripts/import-reviewed-music.py, then trimmed, loudness-normalized and recompressed for the mini-tool package.
policy.sfx: Twenty short event/UI sounds are deterministic, sample-free project audio generated by scripts/generate-audio-sfx.py. sfx_power_failure.mp3 is a reviewed excerpt derived from the user-provided 电流断续时 master.
policy.sourceRetention: Original reviewed masters stay in local ignored music/ and are not committed because the six source files total about 34.5 MiB. Runtime derivatives are the release assets committed under public/assets/audio/.
